fact_english: The pygmy seahorse, found on reefs in the Philippines, is usually less than 2 cm long. It looks so much like the sea fan it lives on that it is extremely hard to see.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang pygmy seahorse sa mga bahura natin, karaniwang mas maliit pa sa dalawang sentimetro!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: At kamukhang-kamukha ng sea fan na tinitirhan niya. Expert sa taguan.

after_text: Doon ko naintindihan: hindi palabas ang ugaling 'yon, sandata ko pala.
why_here: After 'sandata ko pala': the next depth is named right after the break.
